title: Non stick and easy clean up
text: Non stick and easy clean up. I bought one of these at TJ Maxx for camping and loved it for frying eggs so I bought the whole set here. However the pots are definitely light weight so I gave those away. The pans are great for frying and easy cleanup but they aren’t always nonstick. I find that I need to use a spray or some oil for flipping eggs.

product_metadata.title: Copper Chef Black Diamond 10-Piece Non-Stick Induction Cookware Set, Stackable, Pots and Pans
features: 10-Piece Kitchen Cookware Set: Includes 8-inch fry pan, 10-inch fry pan with lid, 2-quart sauce pan with lid, 4.5-quart casserole pan with lid, roasting rack, serving spoon, slotted spatula

Nonstick coating: For easier cooking and effortless cleaning; 2.5 mm thick 3-D diamond matrix surface with raised texture helps food float out easily while fat drains away; scratch-resistant; PTFE & PFOA-free
Stainless Steel comfort handles with steam release vents: Flat tempered glass lids stack and nest for space-saving storage
Induction compatible pans:with stainless steel induction plate heat food rapidly and evenly; works on all stove tops including induction, glass, gas, electric; dishwasher safe or hand wash
description: Black Diamond Cookware from Copper Chef, the #1 Best Selling Cookware Brand in the United States.* Our 10-pc. pots and pans set features an induction bottom that distributes rapid heat across the entire cooking surface from edge to edge. The cooking surface retains heat longer for evenly cooked results in less time. The result is perfectly cooked, beautiful meals without hot spots. We designed our frying pans, casserole pans, and sauce pans with a round shape; frying pans feature a curved edge for easy sliding a stir fry or omelet around. You get the protection you need to cook larger foods like large dinner steaks or more delicate foods like risotto and fish. Bake / roasting rack included. Nonstick Coating Our Copper Chef Black Diamond Cookware set features Cerami-Tech Non-stick ceramic coating with a 2.5mm 3-D diamond matrix surface. Diamond texture design creates micro air pockets between the cookware surface and your food for easier, more effortless food release even with sticky or burnt foods. Sear protein to the perfect golden brown, cook crisp grilled sandwiches, roast ribs and chicken, slow cook your favorite stew and more without having to soak or scrub afterwards. Nesting Pans Set The pans in your Black Diamond Cookware Set are easily stackable with tempered glass flat lids. *Source: The NPD Group / Retail Tracking Service, U.S. Sales, 12 Months Ending December 2017
